meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 当容器里的 AI 助手出问题时，Claude 会按步骤排查：查看日志、检查消息数据库、核对挂载配置，定位问题（如重复服务实例、认证失败、挂载错误），并给出修复命令。
howto.when: 当你报告容器不工作、容器启动失败、认证出错，或想了解容器系统工作原理时触发。

say.text: 容器没回复，帮我查一下是不是有重复服务在跑。
say.note: 会检查进程列表和日志中的适配器警告。

say.text: 容器一启动就退出，看看是不是认证 secret 没配好。
say.note: 会检查 OneCLI 网关和 secret 模式设置。

say.text: 我想看看容器挂载了哪些目录。
say.note: 会用调试模式检查挂载配置。

howto.what_en: When a containerized AI agent misbehaves, Claude investigates step by step: check logs, inspect the session message DBs, and verify mount configs, then pinpoints causes (e.g., duplicate service instances, auth failures, mount issues) and provides fix commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you report container issues, container startup failures, authentication problems, or want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: The container isn't replying; check if a duplicate service is running.
say_en.note: Checks process list and adapter warnings in logs.

say_en.text: The container exits right away; see if auth secrets are misconfigured.
say_en.note: Checks the OneCLI gateway and secret mode.

say_en.text: I'd like to see which directories are mounted in the container.
say_en.note: Checks mount config in debug mode.
